    Description
    ClientEyeRuntime
    Loader-neutral owner of client eye trackers and their simulation lifecycle.
    ClientLifecycle
    Per-tick and disconnect housekeeping for client-side eye state, shared by every loader's client hooks.
    ClientNetworkHandler
    Applies the three server-to-client payloads on the client game thread.
    ClientRenderLayers
    Installs vanilla-model, picker, and optional GeckoLib eye layers after renderer rebuilds.
    EyeInspector
    Client action-bar verdict for whether the aimed entity can currently receive googly eyes.
    GooglyEyeItemRenderer
    Renders a googly_eye item as the actual 3D ModelGooglyEye, tinted by the item's AppearanceOverride.
    GooglyEyeItemRenderer.Unbaked
    The unbaked form named by the item definition; it has no fields.
    GooglyTracker
    Per-entity client-side eye state: the GooglyTracker.EyeInfo pupil-physics simulator for every configured eye, plus which BehaviorInstance (if any) is currently playing on that entity.
    GooglyTracker.EyeInfo
    Physics state for one pupil: its position and velocity in the eye's unit disk, the head orientation used to derive angular forcing, and the non-physical overlay values (grow/blink/tint) an active behavior writes each tick.
    ModelGooglyEye
    Closed, faceted eye geometry used by mob eyes, picker previews, and eye items.
    SlimyEyeIrisTint
    The Slimy Eye iris tint: the stack's stored iris color.
